posts.title: c4
posts.description: A benchmark for hand: LLM agents played Connect 4 against me in a real browser, at 20.7 s and $0.022 a move, and lost every game they finished. The 80-line solver that graded them plays in under a second for nothing. Play it, and watch two solvers play each other.

posts.title: Domain first
posts.description: I wrote what accrete's tools are allowed to do as one Alchemy Domain model. Then I ran the same file in memory, on Cloudflare Durable Objects, and on Effect Cluster with Postgres, and called it from a Foldkit button. 20 agents, three hosts, one build every time.

posts.title: Let the model write the system
posts.description: Don't make the AI do 500 jobs. Make it write the code once. It was 24 times cheaper and got more right.
